nodes.label: 健康状態 / 治療・通院負担
nodes.notes: The source family treats disease profile and treatment burden as part of the work-participation structure rather than background only.

nodes.label: 機能制限 / コミュニケーション制約
nodes.notes: The source explicitly captures symptom and function limits that shape communication and social participation, not only diagnostic status.

nodes.label: 就労参加 / 就職活動 / 就業継続課題
nodes.notes: The patient-side source combines current employment status, job-search barriers, disclosure choices, and recent work difficulties into one occupational-participation frame.

nodes.label: 環境因子 / 支援利用 / 職場配慮
nodes.notes: The source distinguishes accommodation presence, needed-but-absent support, disclosure content, consulted sources, and support preferences instead of collapsing them into one support score.

nodes.label: 個人因子 / キャリア志向 / 将来展望
nodes.notes: ICF does not classify personal factors, but the source family clearly treats qualifications, aspirations, and service-perception context as relevant to work participation.

evidence_links: Nanbyo Kanja.pdf: patient-side question blocks on disease, treatment, and functioning
edges.review_notes: The source family positions symptom and treatment burden as shaping the functional and communication limits that matter in work and daily life.

evidence_links: Nanbyo Kanja.pdf: patient-side question blocks on functioning limits, job search, and recent work experience
edges.review_notes: The source architecture implies that participation barriers are mediated through concrete communication, stamina, and self-management constraints.

evidence_links: Nanbyo Kanja.pdf: patient-side question blocks on disclosure, workplace accommodation, support use, consultation sources, and preferred supports
edges.review_notes: The source does not treat support as a single positive count. It distinguishes fit, unmet need, and navigation barriers around work participation.

evidence_links: Nanbyo Kanja.pdf: patient-side question blocks on work motivation, training, and qualification context
edges.review_notes: The source family allows personal future orientation and qualification path to shape employment strategy and support fit without replacing environmental or health factors.

icf_anchor_policy: ICF remains the main common structural frame. This source-document prior is interpreted as a bounded source-authored guide inside the ICF outer frame.
icd_support_policy: ICD is not used as an explanatory frame here and remains limited to later health-condition normalization support when needed.
